To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the audiological measures were associated with psychomotor and cognitive functions, but not with sensory functions or psychic wellbeing.

1) the audiological measures showed significant decrements in older age groups; 2) the pure-tone thresholds at 4, 000 Hz and the mean of 500, 1,000 and 2,000Hz were significant predictors of speech understanding; 3) the pure-tone threshold at 4,00Hz was a significant predictor of the speech understanding in the 71-75 year-old men; and 4) the speech-understanding scores were significantly related to psych

the audiological functions in older men are significantly poorer than those in younger age groups and that the pure-tone thresholds and speech-understanding scores correlate with each other and with cognitive functions.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the relationship between pure-tone thresholds and speech-understanding tests, and the relationship between audiological functions and other sensory functions, psychic well being, psychomotor and cognitive functions, educational and occupational background, and health.
the relationship between pure-tone thresholds and speech-understanding tests and their correlates in three samples of middle-aged and elderly men.
the auditory functions of a population sample of Finnish men of three age groups (31-35; 51-55; 71-75) and the factors that may be responsible for the differences in these functions.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the results of the present study are in accordance with previous findings and that the auditory functions of men are associated with other sensory, psychomotor, cognitive, and health-related factors.
the auditory functions of men of different age groups were affected by the same factors as the other sensory functions and psychic well-being.
the auditory functions of men of different age groups are affected by the same factors that affect the general health of the individuals.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the pure-tone threshold and speech-understanding tests are sensitive measures of age-related auditory changes, which are related to psychomotor and cognitive functions and occupational and health-related variables.
auditory functions in men are associated with psychomotor and cognitive functions, and that these associations are partly mediated by occupational and educational background.
the pure-tone thresholds and speech-understanding tests were related with each other and that both were related to cognitive functions.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the auditory functions of men in different age groups are related to the same set of factors, which are also related to the auditory functions in each age group.
auditory functions are closely related to other sensory and cognitive functions and to health status.

pure-tone thresholds and speech-understanding tests should be performed together, as the results of both tests are related to each other, and that the auditory functions of older people are affected by the same factors as other sensory functions and cognitive functions, which are also known to be affected by ageing.
